title: Multivariate polynomial identities over an infinite domain
statement: Let $D$ be an infinite commutative integral domain, meaning an infinite nonzero commutative ring without zero divisors, and let $I$ be any set. For $f,g\in D[x_i:i\in I]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], if $f(a)=g(a)$ for every assignment $a:I\to D$, then $f=g$ as polynomials.
